Business Unit
Tencent Games was established in 2003. We are a leading global platform for game development, operations and publishing, and the largest online game community in China.
Tencent Games has developed and operated over 140 games. We provide cross-platform interactive entertainment experience for more than 800 million users in over 200 countries and regions around the world. Honor of Kings, PUBG MOBILE, and League of Legends, are some of our most popular titles around the world.
Meanwhile, we actively promote the development of esports industry, work with global partners to build an open, collaborative and symbiotic industrial ecology, and create high-quality digital life experiences for players.

What the Role Entails
Planning, developing and delivering production database platforms on cloud.
Provides production databases on cloud 24X7 running technical support and services.
Troubleshoot and resolve databases issues.
Databases on cloud optimization and performance tuning.
Databases on cloud fully high availability implementation.
Working with Company R&D to keep the database in latest patching and version.
 

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above in computer science, Information system or related fields
Knowledge of database theory and database system architecture.
Strong in one or more coding languages, such as PHP, Shell, Python, Java etc.
Knowledge of Cloud computing.
High interesting on database technology.
Interesting on solving RDMS and NoSQL problem in a DBaaS environments. 
Strong interpersonal communication skills.
Experience in MySQL, Redis, MongoDB on cloud will be a plus.
Experience in application development base on databases will be plus.
